title: Relaxed Townhouse with a Rooftop. Only Minutes from Downtown
description:
Fix dinner in a classic horseshoe kitchen to serve at a robust hardwood table with button-tufted chairs within this radiant townhouse. Gather on the roof terrace to watch the big game on a widescreen TV while reclining on a wicker lounge chair.
STRP#2017041637

Brand New Townhouse with Private Rooftop deck, 2 bedrooms each with own bathroom and additional 1/2 bathroom. (1 king, 2 queens, 2 queens pullout, and 1 queen air mattress) Great location and also a private entry with gated parking space. Awesome location.

You will have access to the entire home. You will be given an access code to the front door. access to gated parking in the back, 24 hour access available for late travelers if notified in advance.

Please contact me with every question, issue or concern. I’m available on my cell whenever you need me!

This newly-built townhouse is a short cab ride away from the legendary live music clubs that line Broadway, as well as hockey games at Bridgestone Arena. It’s also a short drive from the trendy dining and shopping of 12South.
